context:
Goal: every unrouted item from the coordinator's transcript check reaches the triage that can act on it.
Problem (rule): writing in another repo is your call, and the writing session reaches only claude-settings, so it needs push access added for q_max, banchi, degen, home and mailaudit.
Based on (read): skill project-ops says a note for another repo goes in that repo's outbox on its record branch, in git, so its triage sees it under whichever account runs it.
Based on (read): the child items now sit in claude-settings' own outbox (roadmap/outbox/triage.md), which no child triage reads.
Departs from: main (child items unread in claude-settings' outbox) — moves each to its own repo's outbox.
Meanwhile: the coordinator keeps releasing lanes that fix work on main; nothing else waits on this.
home: skill project-ops (outbox on each repo's record branch)

options.how: The session gets push access to the 5 repos and commits one outbox note in each.
options.label: Yes, add push access and write one note per repo

reply: Your answer in chat, 11:07 CST Nov 10 (relayed by the coordinator 11:10 CST): yes. The coordinator writes each child repo's items into that repo's own outbox. Closed by triage 11:10 CST.
short: Child items into their own outboxes?
title: Should each child repo's unrouted items be written into that repo's own outbox?
why: Each repo's triage reads only its own outbox, so this is the only way the items reach it soon.
